description: Block until the named services (or every service when services is omitted) are healthy, using the same readiness rule as `up --wait` and `status`. Read-only: it changes no files and starts nothing. Returns one envelope with each service's state; a failure names the service and carries its last log lines. Optionally select the project with projectPath. CLI equivalent: `flisk wait --json`.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

services.description: Only wait for these services; omit to wait for every service

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait before giving up (default 1800, at most 21600)

name: wait
